Use the standard Couette flow configuration with two infinite parallel plates separated by a distance of 10 mm.
Set the bottom plate as stationary and the top plate moving at 5 m/s in the positive x-direction.
Assume zero pressure gradient in the flow direction.
Let y be the coordinate measured from the bottom plate toward the top plate, with y = 0 at the bottom plate and y = 10 mm at the top plate.
The steady velocity profile is u(y) = 5 * (y / 0.010) m/s.
The velocity varies linearly from 0 m/s at the bottom plate to 5 m/s at the top plate.
